text:
harper: Quick flag before design review  — the compare table prototype hides performance badges on collapse and the pinned marker vanishes. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/pinned-ux-proto :mag:

leo: Noted. If users pin a variant and then collapse rows they should still see an indication. Right now you can lose the pinned state entirely.

nina: Two low-friction fixes: 1) move the pin to the left gutter so it survives collapse; 2) when collapsed show a micro-chip next to the model name e.g., "Pinned v2". Chip is clearer but eats horizontal space on translations.

devon: Gutter approach seems safer for i18n, but for dense views a sticky compact pinned bar might be more useful. Suggest hybrid: inline gutter for up to 2 pins, compact sticky row for 3+.

harper: Good call. Also, accessibility: the perf badge color (light green) fails contrast at 12px. We should either darken the fill or add a 1px stroke and include an accessible label.

leo: For keyboard, make the pin a button with aria-pressed and label. Example:

```
<button aria-pressed="false" aria-label="Pin model for compare">📌</button>
```

Space/Enter toggles.

nina: Microcopy tweak: change tooltip from "Pin version" to "Pin model for side-by-side compare"  so it's clearer to non-dev users. Also badge tooltip should show "Latency · Cost" with the two numbers split.

devon: Interaction edge-case: if a user pins then applies filters that exclude the pinned model, should we hide it? My vote: show an option "Keep pinned models visible" that promotes pinned rows to top.

harper: I'll prototype two variants for the review: A) gutter pin + collapsed chip B) gutter pin + optional compact sticky bar. I'll include keyboard flows and contrast updates.

ui-bot: Created ticket PD-9012 "compare: pinned visibility + badges contrast + keyboard" and linked the Figma frames.

product-ops: Added acceptance criteria: keyboard focus order, aria labels, contrast ratio >= 4.5:1, and pinned persistence toggle. Assigned to eng-frontend.

leo: Thanks . If the prototype lands, let's also add a short note in the release changelog about the pinned persistence change so existing users aren't surprised.

harper: Will do. Demo in Friday sync.
